---
title: Builtin components
description: DSUI's UI primitives for building adapter pages.
---

DSUI ships 28 builtin components. Adapters compose them in `render` functions — no React, HTML, or CSS crosses the server boundary.

## Layout

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Grid](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/grid) | CSS grid with 1-6 columns |
| [Columns](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/columns) | Multi-column weighted layout |
| [Flex](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/flex) | Flexbox row or column |
| [Stack](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/stack) | Vertical stack with gap |
| [SplitPane](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/split-pane) | Sidebar + content + inspector |

## Data display

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Table](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/table) | Data table with rows, actions, filters |
| [Value](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/value) | Single field from a data source |
| [KeyValue](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/key-value) | Key-value pairs |
| [Meter](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/meter) | Horizontal bar chart |
| [Badge](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/badge) | Status indicator |
| [Icon](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/icon) | Named icon |
| [Collection](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/collection) | Iterate over a data source |
| [ResourceTree](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/resource-tree) | Hierarchical tree navigator |

## Containers

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Card](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/card) | Versatile container with title, badge, link |
| [Section](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/section) | Titled content block |
| [PageHeader](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/page-header) | Page-level header |
| [Tabs](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/tabs) | Tabbed interface |
| [Resource](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/resource) | Data-binding wrapper |

## Input

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Button](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/button) | Clickable action trigger |
| [Form](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/form) | Zod-driven form |
| [Select](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/select) | Dropdown input |
| [TextInput](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/text-input) | Text input field |

## Code

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [CodeBlock](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/code-block) | Read-only syntax-highlighted code |
| [CodeEditor](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/code-editor) | Editable code editor (browser only) |
| [QueryEditor](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/query-editor) | Query editor with explorer sidebar |

## Notebook

| Component | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [Notebook](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/notebook) | Full notebook with markdown + code blocks |
| [NotebookCatalog](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/notebook-catalog) | Notebook listing view |
| [Link](/docs/adapter-sdk/components/link) | Navigational link |
